source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent acorn and two oak leaves progressing from pale construction to a restrained graphite and colored-pencil finish.
source.notes: Keep one plump acorn tilted toward the lower left, one textured cup cap, one short twig, exactly two lobed oak leaves, the larger leaf behind the acorn and the smaller leaf opening to the upper right, simple veins, and one broken shadow stable. No second acorn, squirrel, hand, basket, lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, signature, watermark, or final-only botanical structure.

process_strategy: Lock the acorn egg, cap ellipse and overlap, twig route, two leaf envelopes, vein axes, and shadow in pale construction; establish both complete leaf silhouettes and every cap scale before shading; then add only graphite, warm umber, muted olive, and ochre pencil to the existing forms.

final_elements.name: acorn egg, cap ellipse, twig route, two leaf envelopes, vein axes, and shadow guides
final_elements.description: Pale graphite construction fixes one tilted acorn, the cap overlap, one short twig, exactly two oak leaves, their main veins, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: complete acorn body, cup cap, twig, and two lobed oak-leaf silhouettes
final_elements.description: The outside contours turn the guides into one readable acorn sprig with a large rear leaf and smaller upper-right leaf.

final_elements.name: cap scale rows, acorn tip, leaf midribs, side veins, and stem joints
final_elements.description: A staggered cap pattern, pointed acorn tip, branching veins, and clean joints establish the species-specific structure.

final_elements.name: leaf edge creases, acorn contour hatching, twig grain, and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse texture clarifies the different surfaces and grounds the small still life without filling every quiet paper area.

final_elements.name: graphite values, warm-umber and ochre acorn pencil, muted-olive leaves, paper highlights, and deeper shadow
final_elements.description: Restrained colored pencil separates the nut, cap, twig, and leaves while visible graphite and open paper preserve a sketchbook finish.

rejection_checks: The same acorn tilt, cap overlap, twig route, two leaf shapes, vein directions, crop, and shadow footprint must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one acorn, one cup cap, one short twig, and two lobed oak leaves must appear before the final panel and persist.
No second acorn, squirrel, hand, basket, scenery, word, label, arrow, number, signature, watermark, or final-only botanical structure may appear.

The finish must retain visible graphite and colored-pencil grain rather than glossy botanical illustration or vector-like linework, and every dark pre-final line must survive unless it is a pale erasable guide.
